name: Omni Orlando at Champions Gate
positioning: Omni Orlando Resort at ChampionsGate: an 800-acre golf and water park resort 12 miles from Disney World
best_for: Golfers who want two championship courses on site
Families who want a water park, lazy river and mini golf at the resort
Groups who want villas with full kitchens and golf views

facts.text: The resort spreads across 800 acres of palms and water.
The resort is 12 miles from Disney World and 21 miles from Universal Studios Florida.
Alongside its 36 holes of golf, the resort has an 18-hole miniature golf course.
There are multiple pools, one of them reserved for adults.
The resort has tennis and pickleball courts and an on-site sports field complex.
The fitness center is fully equipped and has Peloton bikes.
Premier Rooms look out over the golf courses and recreation areas.
Sunset Lodge rooms have a bathroom with a walk-in shower and offer access to wellness programs.
The resort charge includes scheduled transport to the Walt Disney World theme parks.
Restaurants serve cuisines from Chinese to Italian to American.
A complimentary shuttle runs from the Villas and Sunset Lodge to the main resort, pools and golf on request.

highlights.text: The resort has a wave pool, an on-site water park and a lazy river.
The resort has two championship golf courses.
Eagles Edge at ChampionsGate uses Toptracer technology, with hitting bays for competing, virtual games and instant feedback.
Two-bedroom villas sleep up to six and three-bedroom villas up to ten, each with a fully equipped kitchen, living area, private terrace or balcony and golf views.
Suites have a king bed, a living area with a sleeper sofa, a marble bath with separate shower, and a private balcony with golf and pool views.

considerations.text: The resort is 12 miles from Disney World and about 26 miles, roughly 53 minutes, from Orlando International Airport.
Parking, self or valet, carries a nightly charge.
WhataHotel notes that resort fees apply and are charged separately at check-in.
